license_policy: Three different second-wave CC0 field recordings; verification source links included; original WAV source is NOT downloaded
media_quality_policy: Public Freesound HQ MP3 previews are lossy; actual bitrate varies and the first 20MB of any long preview cannot establish its true full-file bitrate. The 192 kbps audition MP3 is a transcoding step and cannot restore quality. Do not publish without listening approval; original lossless WAV recordings remain separate.
goal: Three P0 Rain and Thunder second-wave audio audition masters. Review only; no production source IDs or SEO URL promotion
